purpose: Include an unexpected case or justify a casual response.
keywords: N + だって / だって + reason
I can do that job too.
Even a child notices the difference.
I do not want to go. After all, I have an early start tomorrow.
formation: N + だって / だって + reason
restrictions: Nだって means even or also; sentence-initial だって gives a reason, often defensive.
mistake: Avoid the defensive reason use in formal explanations.
